Sophistry. Fraud. Treachery. Self-love.

Such things comprised almost everything he witnessed.

Even if every person in the world despises me, even if I am cursed like this by my own self, that alone—

And then—

He strikes with all his strength, yet his consciousness is not fixed upon the man at all.

The thing the boy means to cut down is only the self obstructing his path.

He swings to remain true to what he has believed, and what he will go on believing.
